title: Intent core and autonomy levels
lead: Typed intents shared by every channel, with a per-person autonomy check (ADRs 0025, 0026).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** channel adapters; LLM interpretation.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Email, Matrix and the PWA must change state the same way, and no message may do more than its sender's level allows.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the notifications interview is done.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Intents with a required level; per-person level and sender IDs from config.
2. Rule-based grammar for the starter commands; item matching via canonical items and aliases.
3. Dispatch returns a short plain-text reply.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; L0 and L1 behave as in ADR 0026.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
